title: ClearFrame right-click actions
body: Add single-image and batch background removal to Finder. Images stay on this Mac. Single results are saved beside the source; batch results go into a new ClearFrame Cutouts folder. Existing files are kept. Requires the IS-Net model prepared in ClearFrame Desktop.
failure: ClearFrame could not finish this operation. Saved images are kept. For batch jobs, see ClearFrame Report.json in the result folder.
